d:
Soniya gandhi ki kitab Belonging: A Journey of Love men nitish kumar ko lekar likhi gaee baton par bihar ki siyasat garma gaee hai. jediyu sansad sanjay jha ne soniya gandhi ki tippani par tikhi pratikriya dete hue saval uthae hain. aakhir soniya gandhi ne nitish kumar ke bare men kya likha aur sanjay jha kyon bharak gae? dekhie puri riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
